symptom: SEC010 stayed silent on a list over `System.User` for a ServiceManager, whose browser showed every row with `Name` blank except their own (`["", "", "demo_manager", ""]`) — the very case the rule was written for (ChipCoV9 FINDINGS, re-check on main)
cause: The rule counted any entity-level read on a specialization as reading the generalization. The real Mendix 11.15 Administration module grants Administration.User `read (FullName, Email)` on Account UNCONSTRAINED: the rows come through, but no `System.User` member is in that rule, so the fields are blank. The unit fixture had modelled that rule as row-scoped, so the tests agreed with the code and not with the platform
insight: A specialization's rule fills ROWS of a list over the generalization, and FIELDS only for members the rule grants — MEMBER_READ rows are qualified by the declaring entity, so the owner prefix tells. Measured on a scratch copy (run --local, HSQLDB, playwright): an Administrator's Account rule grants no System.User member either, yet every name showed — System.User's own rule also opens users whose roles the user role may manage (ManageableRoles FieldEngineer → demo_engineer's name appeared). Build a lint fixture from `show access` / the catalog of a real project, never from the rule as you remember it
